title: Context scorer weights (FP-suppression augment)
description: Per-family logistic context false-positive-suppression weights consumed on-device by Detection/Scoring/ContextScorerWeights.swift as one additive log-odds term at the posterior seam. Decode by family name (never index). status 'placeholder' and 'candidates' stay in build/; the calibrated final is promoted under an approved change plan.

status.description: 'placeholder' ships with every w_family 0 (identity). 'candidates' is trained and locked. 'calibrated' is the installed final, promoted under an approved change plan.

feature_order.description: The canonical 13-feature order; index authority shared with ContextFeatureContract.featureOrder (Swift) and the File-5 fire dump.

families.description: One logistic block per scored family, keyed by PresetThresholdVector.wireName(for:). MRN's key is 'mrn' (its cell_category_key is 'medicalrecord').

feature_scales.description: Per-feature standardization scale; each strictly positive so Swift z = (f - mean)/scale never divides by zero.

w_family.description: Per-family gate set post-hoc by the harness verdict. 0 ⇒ identity (this family contributes nothing); 1 ⇒ active. Fractional reserved as a future damping knob.

support.description: Training-locus counts. Provenance only; not consumed Swift-side.
